title: Move `fileModifiedMap` to context
body:
This PR removes the shared `fileModifiedMap`, in favour of the one attached to the context object. A shared map can cause [issues](https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/issues/4400) when using multiple CSS inputs:

Imagine a setup where `style1.css` and `style2.css` both use the same config file, `tailwind.config.js`:

1. Update `tailwind.config.js`
2. `style1.css` triggers, and as it does it updates the `fileModifiedMap` for its dependencies, including `tailwind.config.js`
3. `style2.css` triggers, but the current modified time of `tailwind.config.js` matches what's in the `fileModifiedMap`, so it doesn't create a new context, and has a stale config.
